title: RK3566 Rev4 — voltage, current and temperature
description: A 74-second engineering video of native PCB placement, modeled startup voltages and currents, resolved U7 switching, and a separately labeled L219 heating estimate.
scope: Saved electrical simulations with an illustrative, single-component DCR-only thermal model. Other component temperatures remain unknown.
limitations: No measured board temperature or spatial thermal solution; L219 thermal resistance and heat capacity are assumed.
Thermal time is a separate 60-second held-load experiment, not continuation of a validated hardware startup.
IC currents, vendor control behavior, real boot and EMC remain unverified.
Video frames choose nearest saved samples; inspect raw results for extrema and nanosecond derivatives.
PCB views project all copper layers in unmirrored top-view coordinates; pad outlines and footprint bounds are simplified.
